name: Example Corp
review_notes: Every headline must state a message with a clear implication, not a topic label. 'Revenue grew 12% driven by Consumer Health' is correct; 'Revenue Overview' is a defect.
No slide may be plain text on a white background. Content must be organised with coloured boxes, cards, panels or callouts.
The deck must mix full-colour and white slides. A long run of identical white slides is a defect.
Icons must never show a white or coloured square around them when placed on a tinted fill.
